run_common_crawl_preprocess: run the CLI to preprocess Common Crawl tables from tar.gz archives into cleaned JSON output
process_example_table: process a single Common Crawl table example dict and return cleaned table with context
clean_context_with_processor: use ContextProcessor to clean HTML tags and split text into valid sentences
remove_invalid_columns: remove table columns that contain invalid tokens, excessive non-ASCII chars, or too many tokens
merge_similar_columns: merge adjacent table columns that have identical or complementary cell values
